# Dev Learning Archaeologist — ResonantOS add-on (git-history ground truth)

Turns a repo's git history into evidence for a learning diagnostic: the
honest headless subset of the Dev Learning Archaeologist methodology served as
a loopback local service. Deterministic Phase 0 (ground truth) and Phase 1
(excavate) — commit counts verified against git rev-list, identity
consolidation, batch-merge detection, commit-type taxonomy, burst-gap cycles,
rework hotspots — plus the vendored methodology documents. Phase 2-5 are agent
judgment work; the service computes the evidence and claims neither.

## Canonical links

- This repo: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-repo-archaeologist
- Canonical upstream: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/dev-learning-archaeologist (MIT, vendored blobs sha256-pinned (VENDOR-PINS.json); source lineage: merged mirror main 7b2be15 (content-matching commit reachable on both forges))
